title: Mantis and Elephant Voyage
description: A giant green praying mantis with purple eyes floats in a swirling cosmic vortex of stars and nebulae, holding a glowing orb. Below, a small green elephant stands on a sailboat with patterned sails, waving its trunk amid colorful spheres floating on the water, set against a dramatic sunset over rolling hills.
prompt: A giant emerald praying mantis with large purple eyes floats inside a swirling cosmic vortex filled with stars and colorful nebulae, reaching toward a glowing orb. In the foreground, a small green elephant stands on a white sailboat with circular patterned sails, waving its trunk on a body of water. Dramatic fiery orange sunset over rolling green hills, colorful spheres floating in the water and air, highly detailed surreal fantasy scene.
